features.description: Extract dependency-safe shared message-plane resolution/opening and implement the deterministic store-backed MsgHandler adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime and ailang messages resolve identical local, hybrid, and GCP message backends under table-tested environment precedence
Send maps sender, inbox, payload, ID, and CreatedAt milliseconds correctly
Recv polls once in oldest-unread order, marks the selected row read, and returns ErrNoMsgAvailable when empty
Subscribe drains current unread rows in order, marks each read, and returns a safe no-op cancel
Misconfiguration returns a named error without silently opening a fallback store

features.description: Install the native Msg context behind granted authority in single and batch runner paths with injectable store setup and exact cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit Msg and auto-inferred Msg both configure the native handler before user code executes
Runs without Msg neither open a message store nor install a handler and retain capability denial
Single and batch paths use one setup contract and tests cover both
Store startup failure is loud and non-zero before user code runs
Every opened backend is closed exactly once with no batch double-close or leak

features.description: Finish native REPL/serve parity, add a checked AILANG example and user-facing semantics, and prove the local round trip end to end.
acceptance_criteria: A hermetic local-store test sends through ailang run, observes the same row, and receives it through a second run
Empty receive returns typed no_message without hanging and bad store configuration exits non-zero
Native REPL and applicable serve paths have tested Msg parity or a documented deliberate exclusion
A checked examples/msg_roundtrip AILANG program demonstrates the feature after consulting ailang prompt
ailang messages behavior, WASM Msg, stub Msg, full tests, lint, and architecture boundaries remain green
